asks: Where does Silo keep copies of the record's head, so that a record rewritten or cut by a program running as you on the Mac shows?
answer: Off the Mac, in an anchor you set: a Git repository whose branch refuses force pushes and deletions, or the team's host. The recorder sends the head there, signed by a key of the Mac that only Silo can use, every minute while it records and when it stops. `silo verify` checks the record against every head the anchor ever received. Until you set an anchor, `silo verify` says that a rewrite by a program running as you would not show.
